8155aeda-de92-45dc-b3af-831b33054977.title: Commander Ray: Sci-Fi Chronicles
8155aeda-de92-45dc-b3af-831b33054977.prompt:
A normal delivery guy named Sam is riding his scooter through the city when his delivery app suddenly glitches. Instead of giving him a normal address, it says:

"Planet Mars — Building 7 — Apartment 404."

He thinks it's a joke… until a mysterious portal opens in front of him.

He accidentally drives through it and lands on Mars.

He walks into a futuristic apartment and says:

Sam: "Delivery for… Ahmed?"

A huge alien opens the door.

Alien: "You are 47 minutes late."

Sam looks at his phone.

Sam: "Traffic."

Suddenly, several alien police officers appear behind him because interplanetary delivery without a permit is illegal.

Sam jumps back onto his scooter and escapes across Mars while aliens chase him.

At the end, he finally reaches the portal and returns to Earth.

His phone immediately shows:

"New Delivery: Moon — Building 3."

Sam looks at the camera:

Sam: "I'm quitting."

END. 😂
